title: Sizesteal
description: A spin-off of the popular lifesteal mod, where you sizes also increases/decreases based on kills and deaths
body:
SizeSteal is a lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21+ that lets players steal size from each other. When you defeat another player, you grow taller and stronger; when you die, you shrink. All changes are permanent until the next battle, and your size is automatically saved across server restarts.

✨ Features

- Size Stealing – Kill another player to grow; die and lose size.

- Permanent Growth – Your scale, jump height, and fall damage multiplier persist across logouts and server restarts.

- Block Breaking Bonus – Break blocks to grow gradually over time.

- Balanced Attributes

- Jump height scales with size.

- Fall damage multiplier adjusts automatically.

- Custom Growth Item – A craftable item that can make you grow on use.
